verdict: Live crawlability and updated positioning pass. Actual assistant citations and search index freshness remain unverified; product explanation and evidence are incomplete.
scope_limits: HTTP user-agent simulations do not establish genuine vendor visits, indexing or citations.
Search samples came from the available search tool, not an authenticated Google Search Console inspection.
No direct prompts were submitted to Meta AI, Grok, ChatGPT, Claude or Perplexity in this audit.
Tests validate covered application behavior, not educational effectiveness or model training.

findings.finding: Search samples return older homepage and About descriptions; the new product identity was not established by these samples.
findings.action: Inspect both language versions of the homepage and recommend page in Search Console, request recrawling, then track the exact product queries and citation URLs. Search samples alone cannot prove a page is absent from an index.

findings.finding: HowOurAIWorks component is not imported or rendered. Live finder headings contain the guide heading and chat prompt, but no process explanation.
findings.action: Render an accurate visible explanation below the finder, covering custom parsing, readiness questions, application-controlled placement, compatible catalog filtering, uncertainty handling and teacher confirmation.

findings.finding: About page describes how the level finder helps but does not attribute development of the AI guide to StemTechLab.
findings.action: Align English and Arabic About descriptions with the developed product, and link the explanation to the existing recommend canonical URL.

findings.finding: Reviewed implementation uses custom application logic and third-party LLM APIs. No reviewed evidence substantiates training a proprietary foundation model or a world-first claim.
findings.action: Publish a factual methodology description separating the custom guidance system from its underlying models. Publish actual training or fine-tuning documentation if such work exists; substantiate priority separately before claiming first.

findings.finding: Live machine-readable overview explains LLM assistance more fully than the visible finder page.
findings.action: Put the useful methodology on the public HTML page too. Do not rely on llms.txt as proof of indexing or citation.
